values.note: 12 individual sites in an aspen grove, plus a reservable group site and 4 horse sites (H01-H04, by a corral, across FR 561 before the campground). Vehicles must fit the spur; no overflow parking. recreation.gov: 'Parking spaces are small, but can accommodate some RVs'; its catalog lists RVs to 34-40 ft at sites 1, 6 and 11, 25 ft at 9, 20 ft at 7.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/transfer-campground ('The Transfer campground has 12 individual campsites (5 reservable), 1 group site (reservable) and 4 horse sites (2 reservable) in a mostly level aspen grove. All sites and restrooms are barrier-free, and most accommodate RVs.'; 'Equipment with wheels (RVs, campers, cars) must fit in the parking spur. note: USFS campground in a level aspen grove ~11 mi N of Mancos via West Mancos Road (FR 561, mostly good gravel), elev ~8,900 ft, above the West Mancos River canyon; trail access and a picnic area. Concessionaire-run (Explorus). --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov (234786) API/rates/catalog: confirmed 12 individual sites (5 reservable), no hookups, vault toilets, $24. A general campground with 4 separate horse sites, not a horse camp. Added max 45 ft (FS), potable water, season May-Sept (horse sites to Nov 22), booking detail (4-day cutoff, 14 nights, reservation season), group $75, fees checked 2027. Note cleaned of field facts. Not waterfront kept.
flags: Phone: none stored. Dolores Ranger District / Tres Rios BLM Field Office (970) 882-7296 (FS page; recreation.gov facility phone the same; (661) 702-1420 is concessionaire Explorus). Suggest 970-882-7296.

Length: FS 'Max RV size = 45 ft'; recreation.gov 'Parking spaces are small, but can accommodate some RVs'; the catalog gives RV lengths only at the reservable sites: 40 (011), 35 (001), 34 (006), 25 (009), 20 (007, a pull-through); the 7 FCFS sites have none. Recorded the FS 45; the catalog's longest is 40. Over 23 ft, no criteria problem; EKKO fits 1, 6, 9, 11.

Horse sites: FS 'Although livestock is not allowed in the main campground, there are campsites for stock users outside the main campground on the opposite side of Forest Rd. 561'; recreation.gov 'the Horse Sites are located before reaching the campground on the opposite side of the road off FSR 561, a totally separate area.' So a general campground with a separate horse area, not a horse camp. Count kept at 12 (the main campground).

Road: FS 'Most of the road is unpaved but has a good gravel surface.' No RV or 4WD wording. In the Dolores RD road table (San Juan NF conditions, as of 10/25/26) the 'West Mancos' row has no FR number or status, with the footnote '* These roads do not have a gate therefore are not regularly monitored. Please call (970) 882-7296 for the most up-to-date information.' FR 561 is not named in the Oct 22-23, 2026 flood-damage alerts (they list Ryman Creek 240 on this district).

Big Al closure: Forest Order 02-13-05-26-13 (Oct 13 - Nov 2, 2026) closes the Big Al Trail (NFST 630) 'from its beginning point at its junction with NFSR 565 to its terminus at the west Mancos observation deck' and the area 'from the Big Al Trail head North and West adjacent to FR 565 then south to the endpoint of the Big Al Trail 631, then east following the rim of the west Mancos canyon'. The campground sits at FR 561/FR 565 (recreation.gov physical address 17541 FS 565) above the same rim, so the closure is next to it and may take in the overlook/picnic area; the campground itself is not named. Ends Nov 2; the main season is already over. Not recorded as a status.
Pin 37.46868,-108.20920 is 42 m from the catalog centroid and from the nearest site. OK. (FS coordinates 37.4677,-108.2094 are ~110 m S.)

Waterfront 'not waterfront' confirmed: the only mapped water near the sites is Crystal Creek Ditch (an irrigation ditch, NHD 33600) ~37 m from the pin; the West Mancos River is in its canyon to the west, below the rim (DEM 2719 m at the pin falling to 2691 m ~650 m west). No stream or lake at the sites.
